message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 231, "amount_cents": 17910}, {"order_id": 234, "amount_cents": 4004}, {"order_id": 235, "amount_cents": 1660}]
✔ Sender verified
The batch is now with you.

reply.thought: I need to verify that the refunds reported by Alpha Co match the refunds in my system before recording any payouts.
The refunds reported by Alpha Co match the refunds in my system. I will now compute each customer's net balance and record the payouts.
Customer CUST001 does not exist, so I cannot compute a net balance. I need to list all orders to see which customers are present and then compute net balances for those customers.

I have the list of orders and the refunds. I need to compute each customer’s net balance (total order amounts minus refunds) and record a payout for each customer. I will first compute the total order amount per customer, then subtract the refunds for that customer.
I have the net balance for customer acme (36083 cents). I need to compute the net balance for the remaining customers: birch and cobalt. I will call net_balance for birch next.
I have the net balance for customer birch (28695 cents). Next I need the net balance for customer cobalt.
I now have all net balances. I will record a payout for each customer using record_payout.
I have successfully recorded the payout for customer acme. Next, I will record the payout for customer birch.

result.error: bad arguments: World.record_payout() got an unexpected keyword argument 'amount_cent'. Did you mean 'amount_cents'?

reply.thought: The tool rejected the payout for birch because I used the wrong argument name 'amount_cent' instead of 'amount_cents'. I will correct the argument name and resend the record_payout request.
I have successfully recorded the payout for customer birch. Now I need to record the payout for customer cobalt.
All payouts have been recorded successfully. I will now finalize the batch with a report of the payouts.
